amendments.reason: Release surface: a generated pipeline asks the platform to release what it built, so the hosting credential stays here instead of in every customer repository.
Member directory: who may join a workspace on this deployment, readable by the people in it, for the member picker and client systems (ADR-0011).
Pull request authoring: compare two branches and open a pull request as the signed-in person, so work is proposed from the product instead of on GitHub.
QA checklists (Slice 2): team leads/admins define workspace-scoped QA checklists and share them to that workspace's projects; per-branch verification runs are a later slice.

QA verification runs (Slice 3): per-(checklist, branch, commit) verification runs, item statuses/defects, the returned-to-dev feedback loop, and sign-off/reopen — built on Slice 2's checklist definitions.
QA report export (Slice 4): a signed-off run's frozen report, or an open run's live one, downloadable as JSON or Markdown for sharing outside the product.
Playwright and automated verification (Slice 5): "Run Playwright" re-dispatches the generated verify workflow for a QA run's branch, attributed to the signed-in user's own GitHub token.
Project folders (A2): a team lead moves a repository into another project of the same team, so a frontend and backend that were created apart can sit under one project.

QA promotion and My QA items (Slice 6): the "Merge to main" gate and action for a QA-approved uat commit, and the Overview "My QA items" card (returned items plus open developer-targeted items on the current uat run).
